objective: Build an evidence-grounded subsurface understanding of Gandhinagar for UI exploration and future 3D generation.

summary.headline: The source is an aquifer mapping and groundwater management report for Gandhinagar district.
summary.abstract: The report covers geology and hydrogeology, aquifer mapping, hydrochemistry, groundwater resources, groundwater-related issues, management recommendations, taluka reports, and supporting well, piezometer, exploration, water-level, water-quality, and litholog annexures. The supplied Atlas artifact establishes document structure and page-level discovery signals; executor evidence is still required before numeric subsurface claims or continuous geometry can be published.

confidence.rationale: Document metadata and section/page discovery are present in the supplied Atlas artifact.

limitations: The supplied Atlas artifact contains discovery metadata and keyphrases, not complete extracted tables.
No continuous aquifer boundary, 3D surface, depth interval, water-level value, or chemistry value is published by this example.
The report's page numbering may include printed-page numbers distinct from PDF page numbers; citations must retain both when executor evidence exposes them.
